content_sections.heading: SAIL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SAIL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SAIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SAIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Consultant (Sports Coach) posts is scheduled for 11 September 2026. Candidates should report at the specified venue within the reporting time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by SAIL for Consultant (Sports Coach) posts?
faq.answer: Steel Authority of India (SAIL) has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the post of Consultant (Sports Coach) across various sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the SAIL Consultant (Sports Coach) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma or higher degree in Sports Coaching from NSNIS, or be a medal winner/participant in national or international sports events representing their state or India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the SAIL Consultant (Sports Coach) role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant (Sports Coach) position is 64 years as of 19 August 2026. Candidates must also be medically fit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the SAIL Consultant (Sports Coach) positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant (Sports Coach) positions ranges from Rs. 28,000/- to Rs. 36,000/- per month, depending on the specific sports discipline.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the SAIL Consultant (Sports Coach) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates need to report at the specified venue on the interview date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the SAIL Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled application form (if applicable), one recent passport-size photograph, and original certificates/documents supporting their eligibility, including educational qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for SAIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for SAIL Consultant (Sports Coach) posts being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Rourkela, Odisha, with the pincode 769002. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the reporting time for the SAIL Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to report for the walk-in interview between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM on the scheduled date.
